user_query: Identify the enzyme family and provide the best-supported catalytic activity and chemical reaction for this protein sequence. Report sequence properties, Pfam/domain evidence, close Swiss-Prot homolog annotations, catalytic residues or motifs if available, cofactors, pathway, cellular localization, and oligomeric state. Clearly distinguish curated evidence from homology-based inference and note uncertainty.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Together with its co-chaperonin GroES, plays an essential role in assisting protein folding. The GroEL-GroES system forms a nano-cage that allows encapsulation of the non-native substrate proteins and provides a physical environment optimized to promote and accelerate protein folding.

catalytic_activity.equation: ATP + H2O + an unfolded polypeptide = ADP + phosphate + a folded polypeptide.
catalytic_activity.raw_annotation:
<ns0:comment xmlns:ns0="https://uniprot.org/uniprot" type="catalytic activity">
        <ns0:reaction evidence="1">
            <ns0:text>ATP + H2O + an unfolded polypeptide = ADP + phosphate + a folded polypeptide.</ns0:text>
            <ns0:dbReference type="EC" id="5.6.1.7" />
        </ns0:reaction>
    </ns0:comment>

subunit: Forms a cylinder of 14 subunits composed of two heptameric rings stacked back-to-back. Interacts with the co-chaperonin GroES.
